text:
cheng: Heads up — CI microbench failed on PR #8920, token_throughput dropped ~18% vs baseline. CI diff attached.
ci-bot: test microbench/token_throughput_test FAILED (threshold +15%)
cheng: repro log snippet:
```
baseline: 1200 tps
current: 980 tps
p-value: 0.001
```
ekaterina: could be kernel selector flip for long sequences — seen similar with seq_affinity changes. Run with KERNEL_SELECTOR_DEBUG=1 to get decisions.
maria: also seeing KV cache hit rate drop in the same run, eviction spikes at start of warmup; flamegraph: https://internal/g/fg/8920
isaac: can we bisect? if it's the selector heuristic we should find the commit quickly.
cheng: started bisect, range HEAD~20..HEAD; first bad commit looks like 8f3b2c0 — changed seq affinity scoring in selector
ekaterina: confirm by running unit microbench locally with `RUST_LOG=debug ./target/release/microbench --test token_throughput --seed 42`
maria: local run shows kv_hit 0.76 -> 0.58 after 8f3b2c0
cheng: attaching perf top-ish lines:
```
  30.4% kernel: matmul_quantized
  18.7% kernel: attention_fused
  12.1% runtime: kv_cache_eviction
```
eng-oncall-bot: deploy of release/2026-03-18 blocked: rollback required if revert not merged within 2h :rotating_light:
isaac: recommend revert PR to unblock rollout — I'll open pr/revert-8920 with revert of 8f3b2c0, then we can run canary
maria: filing revert PR now
cheng: also adding a microbench gate to PR template to catch selector flips; suggest adding `--compare-against baseline` to CI job
ekaterina: also add KERNEL_SELECTOR_DEBUG logs to perf CI artifacts for future triage
ci-bot: re-run requested: microbench rerun queued (job 54321)
maria: rerun shows regression disappears after revert locally
isaac: created revert PR 8920-revert-8f3b2c0, linking here: https://internal/pr/8920-revert
cheng: thanks — marking this thread as rollout-blocker. will hold merge until revert merges and CI green
maria: will follow up with root-cause analysis in a doc once we stabilize
cheng: :thumbsup:
